meta.title: Novel Fish
meta.description: Append local novel text below a separator after real content when actively expanding selected native regions.

chat.noBook: Select a book under Plugins → Novel Fish first.
chat.switchHint: Collapse and actively expand this region to read from the current progress.
chat.readError: The passage could not be loaded; progress did not change.
chat.retry: Collapse and actively expand this region to retry.

settings.title: Novel Fish
settings.description: Import a book and select one or more native region types. Active expansion keeps real content and appends plain novel text below a separator; nothing is sent to the model.
settings.typeHint: Five non-overlapping types; select several, all or none. Only existing native disclosures are adapted. Tool inputs, outputs and chat answers stay intact, with no new controls for non-expandable cards. A different region's first active expansion continues reading.
settings.emptyLibrary: Import an EPUB, TXT, or MD file to begin.
settings.nativeControls: Icons, hover/open chevrons and disclosure interactions remain entirely native to DSH.
settings.nativeTitle: Follow the native DSH region title
settings.noExtra: Follow the native DSH region summary
settings.presetHint: Choose presets without typing; an input appears only when Custom is selected.
settings.removeConfirm: Delete {title} and its local reading progress?
